title: Development and Validation of a Prediction Model for Elevated Arterial Stiffness in Chinese Patients With Diabetes Using Machine Learning.
summary: A machine-learning model predicted elevated arterial stiffness in Chinese adults with diabetes; an external Japanese validation cohort is reported (AUROC 0.821 per the source intake), supporting cross-cohort prediction but not a causal risk-factor interpretation.
